newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end higher, buoyed by firm dollar.
newsitem.headline: German shares end higher, buoyed by firm dollar.

text.p: 1155 GMT - German shares end bourse trade up 0.60 percent, slightly off the day's highs, as the market continues to enjoy the support of the stronger dollar at 1.7325 marks. Firmer overnight close on Wall Street underpinned trade. Resistance seen at 3,400 points, but scepticism about viability of upturn may limit the advance.
* DAX index of bourse trade at 3,383.19 points, up 20.13 points. June DAX future up just 1.0 point at 3,385.
* Degussa down after H1 gp pre-tax profit up 25 pct at 233 million marks, sales at lower end of forecasts, dealers say.
* Daimler up, says to launch new model in Frankfurt.
